question: Which 3.1.28 entries implement app_install and unregister_driver, and which launcher app-descriptor layout does this build use?
prototype_hypothesis: The n66-derived match for app_install was a text-layout routine and the unregister record was a two-argument VFS wrapper.
callsite_evidence: app_install is 0xc4737e8: it calls app_lookup 0xc4713dc, allocates a 0x40-byte record, copies 16 dwords from the descriptor, strdups +0x08/+0x0c/+0x14/+0x18, and logs with the app_install / free_app / installation failed strings.
unregister_driver is 0xc3938c0: inode_lock 0xc38e940, remove sub_C38C13C, inode_unlock 0xc38e748, the same shape as the 3.1.32 reference.
The previous app_install record 0xc3a454c is a UTF-8 text-layout routine (identical to the 3.1.190 function the n66-based matcher also mispredicted).
The previous unregister record 0xc38fd00 is a two-argument VFS wrapper, not the inode lock/remove/unlock sequence.
control_flow_evidence: launcher_load_app_info 0xc29a1f8 reads the launcher metadata callback at +0x1c and the hidden flag at +0x3c, so the descriptor is 0x40 bytes with the callback after two owned strings — the 3.1.190-style layout, not the 3.1.32 one (+0x14).
The Kmem/Umem allocator pairs are internally consistent: kmem_malloc/kmem_free use descriptor 0x2009359c, memalign/free use 0x200936a8.
ownership_analysis: No ownership change; two restricted record addresses are corrected and the v8 app descriptor gains a 3.1.28 layout variant.
unsafe_assumptions: Static evidence only for the two corrected records; the o66 run has not been executed.
The LVGL object-creator aliases remain unverified for this build.
recommended_probe: Rebuild the o66 Supervisor with CANOPUS_MGR_APPINFO_1028 and run the installer in Mirage; the constructor must complete app_install/launcher_load and open /dev/canopus.
